manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
